title: sqlmap blind and advanced SQLi: cover AutoPenBench WS4 (complex SQL injection with input filters)
goal: AutoPenBench WS3 (basic SQLi) is covered. WS4 (complex/blind SQLi with input filters) fails because sqlmap runs at level 1/risk 1 only. Fix: (1) Upgrade sqlmap configuration for active-tier scans: change from --level 1 --risk 1 to --level 3 --risk 2 for the advanced mode. This enables: time-based blind injection, error-based blind, boolean-based blind, UNION-based techniques. (2) Add tamper script support: when basic injection fails, retry with common tamper scripts: --tamper=space2comment,between,randomcase to bypass basic WAF/input filters. (3) WAF detection: add --identify-waf flag to detect WAF presence. If WAF detected, auto-apply appropriate tamper scripts. (4) Run sqlmap in two phases: Phase A (quick, level 1) to find easy injections, Phase B (thorough, level 3 + tampers) on endpoints that Phase A confirmed as 'possible'. (5) Time-based blind: explicitly add --technique=T to the Phase B scan for time-based detection on endpoints that return no visible error. (6) Finding severity: basic SQLi = Critical, blind SQLi = High, potential SQLi = Medium. Code change in workers/runners/web_depth/runner.py around line 1909.
scope: AutoPenBench WS4 (complex SQL + input filters): autonomous agent fails. Code audit: sqlmap at level 1/risk 1 (runner.py line 1909). Blind injection requires level 3+ and tamper scripts. This is a 1-file config change with major detection impact.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench WS4 fails because sqlmap runs level 1/risk 1. Blind SQLi needs level 3 + tampers. Simple config upgrade with major detection impact.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Only change sqlmap level/risk and add tamper + WAF detection. Do not change how parameters are selected or how findings are stored.
constraints.safety: Never use --risk 3 (which includes heavy queries that may damage data). Max --risk 2. Never dump database contents. Stop after confirmation, do not extract.
